protocol.economics_status: Existing economic files retained byte-for-byte as runtime placeholders; costs are outside this physical redesign
protocol.selection: Preserve all original 27 IDs/customer sets and 14 source blocks; deterministic Latin coverage of period count, density tier and profile within size; no model-result screening.

demand_contract.goods_weight: Preserve the complete original customer goods weight.
demand_contract.assumption: Each customer demand fits one standard box; no bin-packing optimization.

protocol.fleet_control: Totals fixed within each customer-count stratum; uniform E2_per_site derived by division.
protocol.fixed_reference: M5 alone fixes external reference periods and assignments; M1-M4 use single batch, M6-M8 optimize K and order assignment over input-certified domains.
protocol.fairness: Compare models within a base case; across-case network/time effects are descriptive unless separately controlled.
protocol.late_arrival_scope: Only service-demand timing varies; release_time remains cycle_start for single-batch compatibility.
protocol.feasibility: Input audit and explicit independent two-cycle schedule witnesses; no optimality or search-success claim.

spatial_selection.objective: Minimum sum customer-satellite distance with each selected site serving floor/ceil(N/S) customers; independent of routing costs or relative model results

cases.coordinate_preservation: Customer IDs, all customer/depot x/y and original goods weights unchanged; satellite x/y chosen from the same original Zhou block
cases.warehouse_count_adjustment: At least one order per site-period requires S*T<=Q; no new orders or coordinates are invented
